free_tier.stated: up to 100 emails per month on a free plan granted on request by email to support; public plans start under USD 4 per month for 1,000 emails
free_tier.notes: Paid usage is metered: the emails sent and received in a billing period are counted and added to the bill, with plans from USD 10 per month for 10,000 emails. The service accepts transactional email only. Every plan includes unlimited domains and from-addresses and 30 days of email retention.

per_object_cap.stated: 30 MB total email size on the HTTPS API; up to 50 addresses in the To field

retention.stated: 30 days of email history on every plan

interface_detail: the HTTPS API at https://app.mailpace.com/api/v1/send, and SMTP at smtp.mailpace.com on ports 25, 587 and 2525 with STARTTLS or 465 with TLS, using the domain's API token as username and password; the interface vocabulary has no smtp term
tooling: curl or any HTTP client, the vendor's libraries for Rails, Laravel, Node.js, Python and Go, or any SMTP client
chaining: the free plan is a test allowance at 100 a month; the paid plan at under USD 4 for 1,000 a month is the usable tier.

limits.value: up to 100 emails per month on the free plan
the free plan is granted on request by email to support, and the onboarding asks for a plan before the first send
the sending domain must be verified by DKIM before any email can be sent

limits_note: counts of things, not rates, so no vocabulary kind names them: up to 50 addresses in the To field of one message. Rate limits apply to high volumes over short periods, with no number stated.

identity_cost.detail: Registration asks for an email and a password of at least 12 characters, with no card field. The onboarding then asks for an organization, a domain verified by a DKIM record, and a plan; the public plans are paid by card, PayPal or Apple and Google Pay, and the free plan of up to 100 emails a month is granted only on request by email to support. A domain the sender controls is required; SPF and DMARC records are optional, enabled as two more DNS records with a CNAME to mailer.ohmysmtp.com.

reliability_note: sending IP addresses are shared across customers and static IPs are not offered
